summary: A truncated max_datagram_frame_size (or min_ack_delay) transport parameter panics on unwrap while parsing the peer's handshake parameters.
Transport parameter values are not checked to occupy their declared length, so surplus bytes are parsed as further parameters and a peer can smuggle in parameters it never encoded.
A peer's large min_ack_delay at low RTT makes Duration::clamp panic (min > max) when ACK_FREQUENCY sending is enabled.
Zero-length STREAM frames in unordered-read mode make RangeSet::replace store an empty range, breaking the set's no-empty/no-overlap invariant.
RESET_STREAM on a stopped stream credits connection flow control again for data already credited by stop(), inflating the local connection window.
